charges.label: Weight component
charges.quote: a weight component of ₹6.00 per kg of billed weight

charges.label: Distance component
charges.quote: a distance component of ₹2.00 per km of the booked lane distance

charges.label: Cold chain premium (20% of freight charge)
charges.quote: Consignments booked as cold chain ... carry a premium of 20% on the freight charge (the sum of the weight and distance components).

accessorials_policy.clause: sagar-roadlines.md — no clause in §1-§6 states that charges outside its schedule are not payable

document_rules.rule: The c-note number quoted on each invoice line must correspond to a Customer booking; lines that cannot be matched to a booking are not payable until reconciled.
The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices; a credit note references the original c-note number and the invoice it corrects.
A credit note must cover the full corrected amount.
The Carrier invoices as trips are pooled, typically fortnightly. Payment is due 21 days from invoice date.

ambiguities.description: The contract states that only standard service is offered under this agreement; it defines no rate for express service. Pricing for a shipment recorded with service_level = express is undetermined under this contract.

The contract only names a premium for cold chain handling. It does not mention fragile or residential handling at all, so it is undetermined whether these attract any premium or surcharge beyond the plain weight/distance freight charge, or whether they fall under some unlisted accessorial arrangement not covered by this agreement.

notes: Encoded: weight_charge (₹6/kg × billed_weight_kg, §1), distance_charge (₹2/km × distance_km, §1), cold_chain_premium (20% of weight_charge+distance_charge when special_handling contains cold_chain, §3). No tiers, no minimums, no invoice-level adjustments stated. accessorials_policy.closed_list=false since no clause states unlisted charges are non-payable. Ambiguities: (1) express service_level has no defined rate since §2 restricts the agreement to standard service only; (2) fragile/residential special_handling flags are not addressed anywhere in the contract, so any premium for them is undetermined.
